parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host whose network domain you want to delete.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainId
parameters.description: The ID of the network domain to be deleted.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host whose network domain you want to delete.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost_std_intl-sg-uq833e2dz02 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
